invariantRules.text: A benefit plan remains identifiable independently of any person, enrollment, payroll deduction, claim or payment.
Changing sponsor, jurisdiction, eligibility, coverage categories or cost-sharing creates an immutable successor plan version.
Eligibility is a versioned plan-owned rule and is neither enrollment nor coverage.
An employee benefit plan is not a WM-POL-012 Public Benefit / Program.
Plan eligibility does not prove enrollment, coverage, claim acceptance or payment.
Valuation is owned by WM-ECO-002 and is not a plan fact.
Payroll deduction configuration is not plan identity and does not prove coverage.
Plan retirement preserves active and historic enrollment references under explicit continuation rules.
Plan versions pin sponsor, jurisdiction, effective interval and source authority.
Missing eligibility evidence is unknown and cannot be coerced to ineligible.
Public-program and employee-plan boundaries remain explicit even when payroll administers statutory contributions.
A claim or use event is outside this candidate and no claim root is minted here.
